"""ComponentResource wrapping S3, RDS, and IAM for application infrastructure."""

import pulumi
import pulumi_aws as aws
from typing import Optional


class AppInfrastructure(pulumi.ComponentResource):
    """
    A component that provisions:
    - S3 bucket with versioning and encryption
    - RDS PostgreSQL instance with deletion protection
    - IAM role for service accounts
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        environment: str,
        db_instance_class: str,
        db_multi_az: bool,
        db_password: pulumi.Output[str],
        enable_replication: bool = False,
        replication_region: Optional[str] = None,
        opts: Optional[pulumi.ResourceOptions] = None,
    ):
        super().__init__("custom:components:AppInfrastructure", name, {}, opts)

        self.environment = environment
        child_opts = pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self)

        # --- S3 Bucket ---
        self.bucket = self._create_bucket(
            name, enable_replication, replication_region, child_opts
        )

        # --- RDS PostgreSQL ---
        self.db_instance = self._create_database(
            name, db_instance_class, db_multi_az, db_password, child_opts
        )

        # --- IAM Role ---
        self.service_role = self._create_iam_role(name, child_opts)

        # --- Secret (DB connection string) ---
        self.db_connection_secret = self._create_db_secret(
            name, db_password, child_opts
        )

        self.register_outputs({
            "bucket_name": self.bucket.bucket,
            "db_endpoint": self.db_instance.endpoint,
            "role_arn": self.service_role.arn,
        })

    def _create_bucket(
        self,
        name: str,
        enable_replication: bool,
        replication_region: Optional[str],
        opts: pulumi.ResourceOptions,
    ) -> aws.s3.BucketV2:
        """Create S3 bucket with versioning, encryption, and optional replication."""

        bucket = aws.s3.BucketV2(
            f"{name}-assets",
            bucket=f"{name}-assets-{self.environment}",
            tags={"Environment": self.environment, "ManagedBy": "pulumi"},
            opts=opts,
        )

        # Versioning
        aws.s3.BucketVersioningV2(
            f"{name}-versioning",
            bucket=bucket.id,
            versioning_configuration=aws.s3.BucketVersioningV2VersioningConfigurationArgs(
                status="Enabled",
            ),
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=bucket),
        )

        # Encryption (AES-256)
        aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationV2(
            f"{name}-encryption",
            bucket=bucket.id,
            rules=[
                aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationV2RuleArgs(
                    apply_server_side_encryption_by_default=aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationV2RuleApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefaultArgs(
                        sse_algorithm="AES256",
                    ),
                    bucket_key_enabled=True,
                )
            ],
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=bucket),
        )

        # Block all public access
        aws.s3.BucketPublicAccessBlock(
            f"{name}-public-access-block",
            bucket=bucket.id,
            block_public_acls=True,
            block_public_policy=True,
            ignore_public_acls=True,
            restrict_public_buckets=True,
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=bucket),
        )

        # Cross-region replication for prod
        if enable_replication and replication_region:
            self._setup_replication(name, bucket, replication_region, opts)

        return bucket

    def _setup_replication(
        self,
        name: str,
        source_bucket: aws.s3.BucketV2,
        replication_region: str,
        opts: pulumi.ResourceOptions,
    ) -> None:
        """Configure cross-region replication."""

        # Replication IAM role
        replication_role = aws.iam.Role(
            f"{name}-replication-role",
            assume_role_policy="""{
                "Version": "2012-10-17",
                "Statement": [{
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Principal": {"Service": "s3.amazonaws.com"},
                    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                }]
            }""",
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self),
        )

        # Destination bucket (in replication region)
        dest_provider = aws.Provider(
            f"{name}-replication-provider",
            region=replication_region,
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self),
        )

        dest_bucket = aws.s3.BucketV2(
            f"{name}-assets-replica",
            bucket=f"{name}-assets-{self.environment}-replica",
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self, provider=dest_provider),
        )

        aws.s3.BucketVersioningV2(
            f"{name}-replica-versioning",
            bucket=dest_bucket.id,
            versioning_configuration=aws.s3.BucketVersioningV2VersioningConfigurationArgs(
                status="Enabled",
            ),
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=dest_bucket),
        )

        # Replication policy
        aws.iam.RolePolicy(
            f"{name}-replication-policy",
            role=replication_role.id,
            policy=pulumi.Output.all(source_bucket.arn, dest_bucket.arn).apply(
                lambda args: f"""{{
                    "Version": "2012-10-17",
                    "Statement": [
                        {{
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Action": ["s3:GetReplicationConfiguration", "s3:ListBucket"],
                            "Resource": "{args[0]}"
                        }},
                        {{
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Action": ["s3:GetObjectVersionForReplication", "s3:GetObjectVersionAcl"],
                            "Resource": "{args[0]}/*"
                        }},
                        {{
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Action": ["s3:ReplicateObject", "s3:ReplicateDelete"],
                            "Resource": "{args[1]}/*"
                        }}
                    ]
                }}"""
            ),
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=replication_role),
        )

        # Replication configuration
        aws.s3.BucketReplicationConfig(
            f"{name}-replication",
            bucket=source_bucket.id,
            role=replication_role.arn,
            rules=[
                aws.s3.BucketReplicationConfigRuleArgs(
                    id="replicate-all",
                    status="Enabled",
                    destination=aws.s3.BucketReplicationConfigRuleDestinationArgs(
                        bucket=dest_bucket.arn,
                    ),
                )
            ],
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=source_bucket),
        )

    def _create_database(
        self,
        name: str,
        instance_class: str,
        multi_az: bool,
        db_password: pulumi.Output[str],
        opts: pulumi.ResourceOptions,
    ) -> aws.rds.Instance:
        """Create RDS PostgreSQL with deletion protection and backups."""

        # Subnet group (uses default VPC subnets)
        subnet_group = aws.rds.SubnetGroup(
            f"{name}-db-subnet-group",
            description=f"DB subnet group for {name}",
            tags={"Environment": self.environment},
            opts=opts,
        )

        # Security group - no public access
        security_group = aws.ec2.SecurityGroup(
            f"{name}-db-sg",
            description=f"Security group for {name} RDS",
            ingress=[
                aws.ec2.SecurityGroupIngressArgs(
                    protocol="tcp",
                    from_port=5432,
                    to_port=5432,
                    cidr_blocks=["10.0.0.0/8"],  # Internal only
                )
            ],
            tags={"Environment": self.environment},
            opts=opts,
        )

        db_instance = aws.rds.Instance(
            f"{name}-postgres",
            identifier=f"{name}-postgres-{self.environment}",
            engine="postgres",
            engine_version="16.3",
            instance_class=instance_class,
            allocated_storage=20,
            max_allocated_storage=100,
            storage_type="gp3",
            storage_encrypted=True,
            db_name="appdb",
            username="dbadmin",
            password=db_password,
            multi_az=multi_az,
            db_subnet_group_name=subnet_group.name,
            vpc_security_group_ids=[security_group.id],
            publicly_accessible=False,
            deletion_protection=True,
            backup_retention_period=7,
            backup_window="03:00-04:00",
            maintenance_window="sun:04:00-sun:05:00",
            skip_final_snapshot=False,
            final_snapshot_identifier=f"{name}-postgres-{self.environment}-final",
            tags={"Environment": self.environment},
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self, protect=True),
        )

        return db_instance

    def _create_iam_role(
        self,
        name: str,
        opts: pulumi.ResourceOptions,
    ) -> aws.iam.Role:
        """Create IAM role for service accounts with least-privilege access."""

        # Trust policy - OIDC for prod, instance profile for dev
        if self.environment == "prod":
            assume_role_policy = """{
                "Version": "2012-10-17",
                "Statement": [{
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Principal": {"Federated": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE"},
                    "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                    "Condition": {
                        "StringEquals": {
                            "oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE:sub": "system:serviceaccount:default:app-service-account"
                        }
                    }
                }]
            }"""
        else:
            assume_role_policy = """{
                "Version": "2012-10-17",
                "Statement": [{
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Principal": {"Service": "ec2.amazonaws.com"},
                    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                }]
            }"""

        role = aws.iam.Role(
            f"{name}-service-role",
            name=f"{name}-service-{self.environment}",
            assume_role_policy=assume_role_policy,
            tags={"Environment": self.environment},
            opts=opts,
        )

        # Least-privilege policy: S3 access to specific bucket only
        policy_document = pulumi.Output.all(self.bucket.arn).apply(
            lambda args: {
                "Version": "2012-10-17",
                "Statement": [
                    {
                        "Sid": "S3BucketAccess",
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Action": [
                            "s3:GetObject",
                            "s3:PutObject",
                            "s3:DeleteObject",
                            "s3:ListBucket",
                        ],
                        "Resource": [
                            args[0],
                            f"{args[0]}/*",
                        ],
                    },
                    {
                        "Sid": "RDSDescribe",
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Action": ["rds:DescribeDBInstances"],
                        "Resource": "*",  # Describe requires wildcard resource
                    },
                ],
            }
        )

        aws.iam.RolePolicy(
            f"{name}-service-policy",
            role=role.id,
            policy=pulumi.Output.from_input(policy_document).apply(
                lambda p: pulumi.Output.json_dumps(p)
            ),
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=role),
        )

        return role

    def _create_db_secret(
        self,
        name: str,
        db_password: pulumi.Output[str],
        opts: pulumi.ResourceOptions,
    ) -> aws.secretsmanager.Secret:
        """Store DB connection string in Secrets Manager."""

        secret = aws.secretsmanager.Secret(
            f"{name}-db-connection",
            name=f"{name}/db/connection-{self.environment}",
            description=f"Database connection string for {name}",
            tags={"Environment": self.environment},
            opts=opts,
        )

        connection_string = pulumi.Output.all(
            self.db_instance.endpoint, db_password
        ).apply(
            lambda args: f"postgresql://dbadmin:{args[1]}@{args[0]}/appdb"
        )

        aws.secretsmanager.SecretVersion(
            f"{name}-db-connection-version",
            secret_id=secret.id,
            secret_string=connection_string,
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=secret),
        )

        return secret

## `__main__.py`

```python
"""Main entry point for Pulumi program."""

import pulumi
from components import AppInfrastructure

config = pulumi.Config()

# Required config
environment = config.require("environment")
db_instance_class = config.require("dbInstanceClass")
db_multi_az = config.get_bool("dbMultiAZ", False)
db_password = config.require_secret("dbPassword")

# Optional config
enable_replication = config.get_bool("enableReplication", False)
replication_region = config.get("replicationRegion")

# Create infrastructure
infra = AppInfrastructure(
    "app",
    environment=environment,
    db_instance_class=db_instance_class,
    db_multi_az=db_multi_az,
    db_password=db_password,
    enable_replication=enable_replication,
    replication_region=replication_region,
)

# Exports
pulumi.export("bucket_name", infra.bucket.bucket)
pulumi.export("db_endpoint", infra.db_instance.endpoint)
pulumi.export("service_role_arn", infra.service_role.arn)
pulumi.export("environment", environment)
```

## Usage

```bash
# Initialize and select dev stack
pulumi stack init dev
pulumi config set environment dev
pulumi config set dbInstanceClass db.t3.micro
pulumi config set --secret dbPassword "your-secure-password"

# Deploy dev
pulumi up

# Switch to prod
pulumi stack init prod
pulumi config set environment prod
pulumi config set dbInstanceClass db.t3.medium
pulumi config set dbMultiAZ true
pulumi config set enableReplication true
pulumi config set replicationRegion us-west-2
pulumi config set --secret dbPassword "prod-secure-password"

# Deploy prod
pulumi up
```

## Acceptance Criteria Coverage

| Criterion | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| Bucket versioning/encryption | `BucketVersioningV2`, `BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationV2` |
| No public access | `BucketPublicAccessBlock` with all flags true |
| RDS deletion protection | `deletion_protection=True`, `protect=True` |
| Backup retention ≥ 7 days | `backup_retention_period=7` |
| No public RDS | `publicly_accessible=False`, SG restricted to 10.0.0.0/8 |
| Secret encryption | `config.require_secret()`, Secrets Manager |
| Least-privilege IAM | Scoped S3 actions, specific bucket ARNs |
| Environment isolation | Separate stack configs, independent state |
